_comment: Gallery projects, moved out of src/gallery.njk so the seven entries are
labelled by one template instead of seven hand-maintained copies.
NOTHING HERE IS A NEW CLAIM. Every title, location, alt text and caption
is transcribed verbatim from the markup that was already published.
`category` classifies the title and captions that were already there
(a dispensary, a dormitory and a self-storage facility are commercial;
the rest are residential). `shows` summarises that project's own
captions and nothing else - it names which parts of the building the
photographs cover, not the scope of work performed.
DO NOT add a `role` or `builtBy` field until the owner confirms project
attribution. Research 'Website Evidence and Business Facts.md' is
explicit: confirm whether each project was performed by the company or
represents the founder's earlier employment / oversight experience, and
do not imply sole company authorship of every pictured building. The
note in gallery.njk exists because that question is still open.
The '50,000 SF' figure in the Lovell Dormitory caption was already
published and is preserved verbatim. It has not been independently
verified here.
`footerThumb` marks the two projects shown in the 'Recent Work' strip in
every page footer (see src/_includes/base.njk). Those two images and
alt texts were hardcoded there before and are kept verbatim. The alts
name the town because a footer thumbnail has no caption beside it.
Deck and Railings and Porches and Upper Balcony were hand written in gallery.njk and moved here (last two on purpose).
Some photos were dropped from both at the owner's request. `w`, `h` and `widths` are the jpg size and the responsive webp widths
that exist in assets/img/r; `compact` marks the two projects whose photos are small (under 900px wide), so layouts show them smaller.
An 'ADU Concepts' category (two AI-generated architectural illustrations, not completed projects) existed
here from October 2026 to October 2026 and was removed at the owner's request. Do not re-add AI-generated
or other non-completed-project images to this file without a clear, prominent disclosure that the owner
has explicitly reviewed and approved - every other entry here is a real, built project and visitors are
entitled to assume that's true of everything in this gallery.
